title: geniostoma rupestre var. myrtifolium
intro: Geniostoma rupestre var. myrtifolium, commonly known as Mountain Geniostoma or Forest Geniostoma, is a type of flowering plant in the family Tetrameristaceae. It is native to the Pacific Islands, particularly in the forests of Fiji and Samoa. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Geniostoma rupestre var. myrtifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
